selection.stopping_rule: Audit all 60 candidates; do not stop after favorable or unfavorable results.

collection.stored_data: path-derived counts, bounded example paths, exact SHA and truncation state

classification.contradicted_by_paths: at least one non-vendored test path or explicit test config exists at the exact SHA
classification.supported_missing_surface: complete recursive tree contains no test path or explicit test config
classification.inconclusive: repository unavailable or recursive tree truncated
classification.boundary: A path proves repository test material exists, not that it is runnable or relevant to the current root. Absence of a path does not prove absence of behavioral validation.

verdict_rule: LOW_NOISE_PATH_PROXY requires every threshold. HIGH_FALSE_POSITIVE_RISK means the contradiction threshold fails. INSUFFICIENT_PATH_EVIDENCE means completeness fails. No result establishes business relevance, user acceptance or defect-prevention value.
